bugs.title: Image-to-text recognition fails to load the Tesseract JavaScript chunk
bugs.error: Text recognition failed: Loading chunk node_modules_pnpm_tesseract_js_7_0_0_node_modules_tesseract_js_src_index_js failed. (error: http://127.0.0.1:4300/node_modules_pnpm_tesseract_js_7_0_0_node_modules_tesseract_js_src_index_js.js)

findings: OcrEngineService dynamically imports tesseract.js when recognition first runs.
The installed Tesseract version is 7.0.0; its package entry point is src/index.js.
The reported development server at 127.0.0.1:4300 was unreachable during investigation.
Starting the development server failed because Node.js v24.11.0 does not meet the installed Angular CLI requirement: v22.22.3, v24.15.0, or v26.0.0 minimum on the corresponding release line.
investigation.rootCause: Not confirmed; the reported chunk-loading failure has not been reproduced.

nextSteps: Use a supported Node.js runtime and reproduce the error with ng serve on port 4300.
Inspect the failing chunk request and generated lazy-loading graph before choosing a fix.
Record requirements, design and an executable task in specs/pdf-viewer-editor/tasks.md before implementation.
Preserve lazy loading and bundled offline OCR assets; verify real recognition and targeted tests.
Update the task checklist, canonical evidence, completion graph and index sequence after successful completion.
